item.title: Santa Monica Chamber spotlights women shaping city's future
item.description: Over 150 business leaders attended Santa Monica Chamber's Power of Women in Leadership Luncheon, honoring UCLA Health, Shore Hotel, and Snapchat executives for their role in the city's economic recovery.

item.title: Santa Monica Mayor Calls Special Meeting on Grant Dispute
item.description: Santa Monica Mayor Caroline Torosis called a special City Council meeting to revise neighborhood grant restrictions after 3 groups rejected funding.

item.title: Courts host education event in Santa Monica
item.description: The Los Angeles County Superior Courts held a pop-up educational experience at the Santa Monica Courthouse on Tuesday. The event included displays providing educational and historic information about the court system, jury duty and legal protections. The information will be on display until 2 p.m. Tuesday.

item.title: Amy Ephron's New Mystery Novel Set in 1939 NYC
item.description: Bestselling author Amy Ephron releases 'Unseasonably Cold,' a period mystery set in 1939 New York about a socialite's disappearance, out May 12.

item.title: Maria Shriver Keynotes Think Pink Event in Pacific Palisades
item.description: Maria Shriver will keynote the 20th annual Think Pink for Women's Wellness on April 29 at Bel-Air Bay Club in Pacific Palisades, benefiting Providence Saint John's Health Center.

item.title: Samohi Film Teacher Ruth Carter Inspires Student Voice
item.description: Ruth Carter teaches filmmaking at Santa Monica High School, helping students develop storytelling skills through hands-on production roles and collaborative projects.

item.title: LA County to Study Warner Bros Merger Job Impact
item.description: LA County Board unanimously approved motion to analyze Warner Bros Discovery-Paramount merger effects on 312,000+ entertainment jobs in region.

item.title: SMC Student Newspaper Wins 23 National Journalism Awards
item.description: Santa Monica College's student newspaper The Corsair earned 23 awards including a prestigious national ACP Pacemaker, one of only 6 California schools honored.

item.title: Free April Events at Santa Monica Place: Dancing & Music
item.description: Santa Monica Place hosts free April events including Western Wednesdays line dancing, live music April 10-11, kids programs, and Makers Market with 35+ local artisans.

item.title: SMC Planetarium Deep Space Shows Throughout April
item.description: Santa Monica College Planetarium hosts live Deep Space shows Fridays 6-7pm and Sundays 1-2pm throughout April. Topics include nebulae, Milky Way, and galaxies. Tickets $10 adults, $7 kids at smc.edu/tickets.
